algorithm.union: DOM rect plus each non-inset shadow translated by (x,y) and expanded by spread + ceil(1.5 × blur), plus visible outline expanded by width + offset. Members rasterized outward.
algorithm.comparison: Exclude baseline union and candidate union shifted up by delta; compare only their unshifted union at identical scroll.
